record.recipeName: Thai Green Curry Sauce – Bagged (Fish & Tofu)

ingredients.name: Red Onion, fine dices (blitz in processor)
Salt - to start, taste and adjust (up to 1/4 cup)
Water (rinse out paste container and tins)

instructions: Saute Garlic in oil briefly (don't brown)
Add Onion and a splash of water. Sweat until completely soft, no colour (10-15 min)
Add Lemongrass and Curry Paste, fry 3-5 min until fragrant
Add Coconut Milk (keep 1 L back for the slurry) and the Water
Simmer gently 10 min - do not hard boil, coconut milk can split
Whisk Corn Starch into the reserved cold Coconut Milk to make a slurry
Stir into the pot and simmer 3 min, scraping the bottom, until glossy and thick. Should coat a ladle heavily - if too thin, add 1/4 cup Corn Starch in 1/2 cup cold water and simmer 2 min
OFF THE HEAT: remove ALL Lemongrass
Add Lime Juice, Cilantro and Salt - taste and adjust. (Lime goes in last - boiling it thins the sauce)
Cool in 6" hotel pan in the blast chiller: 60 to 20 °C within 2 h. 20 to 4 °C within 4 h
Vac bag cold, about 5 lbs per bag (approx. 4 bags), press flat. Label with name, cook date, use-by and allergens
Fold in Cilantro off heat to preserve brightness.
